name: Vandana Shiva
shortBio: Indian physicist, philosopher of science, and ecofeminist thinker who traced ecological crisis and agrarian dispossession to Western mechanistic reductionism and intellectual property enclosures ("biopiracy").
centralQuestion: How do capitalist scientific reductionism and patriarchal development models construct "monocultures of the mind" that destroy biodiversity and women's ecological knowledge?

keyWorks.title: Staying Alive: Women, Ecology and Development
keyWorks.description: Landmark Global South ecofeminist text linking Baconian science, maldevelopment, and indigenous women's regenerative ecological knowledge (Prakriti).

keyWorks.title: Monocultures of the Mind
keyWorks.description: Philosophical critique of epistemic homogenization in modern industrial agriculture and biotechnology.
